name: VoiceType
tagline: Offline speech-to-text & subtitle editor using permissive OSS models (Vosk).
description: Transcribe audio and video to text completely offline using the permissively-licensed Vosk engine — no cloud, no API keys. Generate and edit SRT/VTT subtitles with timestamps, transcribe recordings and meetings, and export plain text. Language models are downloaded on first use (Apache-2.0).
